append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1626). The hole was at the app layer, not RLS: joinRoom wrote room_members through the admin client, and RLS (ADR-1149) deliberately lets any signed-in member read a scoped room's row. joinRoom now reads scope_id with visibility and, for anything not plainly public, asks belongsToRoomScope (lib/messages/room-scope.ts) for the caller before the upsert, fail-closed. Circle: an active membership, the host_id, or an active stewardship edge. Hub: an active membership in a Circle under it, the guide_id, or an edge. Nexus: an active membership in a Circle under it, the mentor_id, or an edge. Outpost: an active membership in a Circle under a Nexus of it, or an edge. Channel: tuned in. The walk reads up from the caller's own memberships. A scope-less scoped room, an unknown kind or a read error refuses. inviteToRoom asks the same of the invitee on a scoped room, so a Circle room member cannot pull an outside friend in. No migration. TESTS: app/(main)/messages/rooms/actions.join-scope.test.ts runs the real action on an in-memory place tree: a stranger is refused at each of the five scoped kinds with no row written, and a Circle member tuned into the Channel gets into all five; plus lapsed membership, scope-less and unknown kinds refused, host and Outpost steward admitted, public open, invite refused for an outsider and allowed for an insider. Mutation-checked: disabling the gate fails 9 tests; a gate that always refuses fails 8. NOT DONE: the room page still offers Join to an outsider (the press now reaches the refusal), and room_members rows written earlier for outsiders are not swept (not measured; no production read).
